about_the_game:
[Launch! Mine! Survive!] Your interstellar miner adventure begins now!

《Pinball Prospectors》is a mining adventure game that blends pinball physics with Roguelike elements! Control your orb-launching rig, delve deep into the interiors of randomly generated, dangerous asteroids, collect precious resources, defeat greedy "Competitors", and continuously upgrade your rig to push deeper into richer mining zones!

Launch & Mine

Precisely control your launcher! Use the physical ricochet of pinballs, combined with their unique traits, to accurately strike resource-bearing blocks!

Upgrade

Use the resources you gather to upgrade your rig. Generate new pinball, enhance pinball abilities, improve rig maneuverability, and use "Special Resources" to unlock powerful new rig capabilities.

Combat

Beware! Other resource harvesters (Competitors) will come to cause trouble. Before they get close and sabotage your rig, strategically use precise ricochets to defeat these intruders and protect your hard-earned loot. Stay alive to bring resources home!

Permanent Upgrades

Use the "Rare Resources" brought back from asteroids to permanently upgrade your "Rig". This lets you explore deeper, more resource-rich asteroid mining zones!
